articles.summary: Medifast (NYSE: MED), the metabolic health and wellness company known for its science-backed comprehensive metabolic health system, Trilivy™, will announce financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 on Monday, October 26, 2026, before market open. The Company will host a conference call to discuss the results with additional comments and details. Company participants will be Nick Johnson, Chief Executive Officer, and Jim Maloney, Chief Financial Officer. The conference call is scheduled to begin at 8:30 a.m. ET on October 26, 2026. The call will be broadcast live over the Internet, hosted on the Investor Relations section of Medifast's website at www.MedifastInc.com or directly at https://viavid.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1777297tp_key=e45ccefd73 and will be archived online and available through January 26, 2027. articles.summary: Medifast (NYSE: MED), the metabolic health and wellness company known for its science-backed comprehensive metabolic health system, Trilivy(tm), today reported results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Revenue: $72.0 million, with revenue per active earning coach of $7,064 Independent active earning coaches of 10,200 Net loss of $17.5 million (non-GAAP adjusted net loss of $2.1 million) Loss per diluted share ("EPS") of $1.57 (non-GAAP adjusted loss per diluted share of $0.19) Cash, Cash Equivalents, and Investment Securities of $172.5 million with no debt Nick Johnson, Medifast's Chief Executive Officer, commented, The third quarter was about execution. With Trilivy now live, Reset Fuelings in our coaches hands, and our new compensation plan and Coach Hub launched, the major pieces of our 3.0 strategy are now in market.
